name: mouthband
description: Beatbox the drums. Hum the bassline. Whistle the melody.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sim: npm run build && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ../ios-build -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath ../ios-build/spm -packageCachePath ../ios-build/spm-cache -disablePackageRepositoryCache CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
